name: Skeleton
flavour: It does not know it is dead. It knows you are not.
art_prompt: a skeleton in a clean readable game-art style: warm ivory bone with soft warm beige shading, clean with no stains, a slightly large skull with big dark hollow eye sockets and a row of square teeth, a clear ribcage, spine and pelvis, slim arm and leg bones with rounded joints, bony hands and feet, no clothes, no weapon, both arms stretched straight out in front at shoulder height like a sleepwalking zombie, the bony hands reaching forward, standing and facing the viewer
motion: a skeleton walking slowly with both arms stretched straight out in front like a zombie
back_hint: seen from behind: the back of the skull, the spine running down between the shoulder blades, the back of the ribcage and the pelvis, both arms raised straight out in front so only the shoulders and upper arms show, no face
dead_hint: collapsed into a low loose heap of bones, dead: every bone fallen into one flat pile, the skull resting on top, the ribcage broken apart, arm bones, leg bones, feet and vertebrae all jumbled inside the pile with nothing sticking out below it; the pile sits on nothing, with no ground, no sand, no dirt patch and no shadow under it
doc: The crowd: bare bones shuffling in with their arms out like sleepwalkers, six to a pack, half a slot each against the cap. Everything else is measured against it. It falls apart into a heap of bones when it dies.
